name: Neumorphic
description: Soft UI: rounded, cushioned corners and a deeply rounded plate, surfaces extruded from the page by a paired shadow, dark below and right and lit above and left, wells pressed in the same way, no card edges, rules pressed as a wide soft groove, hairline control borders, comfortable density, and a soft press with no lift.

provenance.attribution: Keyur Golani, for the keyurgolani.name portfolio platform.
provenance.derivation: The reviewed prototype's soft recipe, with its --appearance-* references read as --color-*, and the contract's signature-fill and emphasis-glow at the fallback language's values.

fallbacks: Under reduced transparency, without backdrop-filter, in forced colors, and in print, surfaces render opaque and the backdrop blur is 0.
Under reduced motion, transforms and emphasis stop and entrances and exits fade; a paused boundary and print are instant.
In forced colors, the material is a solid surface, and shadows and texture drop.
caveats: Controls carry a hairline border the prototype didn't have, so they meet 3:1 non-text contrast.

tokens.shadow-card: 8px 8px 16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 16%, transparent), -8px -8px 16px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-canvas) 85%, transparent)
tokens.shadow-overlay: 12px 12px 24px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 18%, transparent), -12px -12px 24px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-canvas) 85%, transparent)
tokens.shadow-raised: 5px 5px 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 16%, transparent), -5px -5px 10px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-canvas) 85%, transparent)
tokens.shadow-inset: inset 4px 4px 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-text-primary) 16%, transparent), inset -4px -4px 8px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-canvas) 85%, transparent)
